items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the Kunneth components of the class of the diagonal pair to plus or minus the Kronecker symbol (statement lines 2860-2873). The proof (proof lines 2874-2899) identifies the class of the diagonal as the pushforward of the unit, expands its Kunneth decomposition, and computes the pairings through the multiplicativity of the degree map. H3: a computation with an explicit choice of dual class, written out in full.
